description: The file defines data structures, function prototypes, and a type definition related to reachability analysis within a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for adding unseen objects, marking reachable objects, and references to progress tracking and object info.

methods.name: add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal
methods.description: Function to add unseen recent objects to a revision traversal, with callback support.

methods.name: mark_reachable_objects
methods.description: Function to mark objects as reachable within a revision info context.
